customManagers.description: The gitleaks release the Secret Scan job downloads, with the sha256 of its archive (read from the release's checksums file)

packageRules.description: pnpm refuses lockfile entries published less than a day ago (minimumReleaseAge, default 1440 minutes), so CI's frozen install fails on a release that is too new. Hold npm updates for 3 days, leaving a margin for transitive dependencies pulled in with them.
